observation.PID_response: float sequential sum of native gas concentrations
observation.aggregation: same native accepted gas messages; float sequential sum / integer count

receptor_schedule.reference_sampling: native SampleConcentrations at captured service xyz; choose current frame by new bank actual header time <= physical_target_s < next header; no frame filename extrapolation
receptor_schedule.bank_membership_ambiguity_policy: retain both 50-block branches; score changes/disagreements produce HOLD

map_operator.fixed_wind_covariates: native block average TO direction and speed; identical for all candidates
map_operator.anchor: original B4 50 binary events reconstruct logOdds/omega/confidence vs frozen native final input.csv before new evidence interpretation
map_operator.comparison: mean reference belief maps vs heldout/observed belief map: descriptive same-object similarity; not independent grid likelihood

scores.report: per block, per stop, per complete heldout realization, both membership branches
scores.independence_label: marginal/composite predictive score; NOT joint likelihood or calibrated posterior

source_blinding.candidate_ids: anonymous, no coordinates or true/wrong roles
source_blinding.heldout_ids: opaque task; no generating candidate supplied to scoring
source_blinding.freeze: hash source-blind input and output prior to identity-unblind step
source_blinding.unblind: separate label file only after score artifact freeze

unaligned_control.definition: I[native 3D SampleConcentrations(x,y,z)>0 ppm] at same physical sampling time; temporal mean at cell then reference-realization mean
unaligned_control.scope: ideal nonzero arrival; not thresholded PID event; not native 2D filament-centre grid occupation
unaligned_control.full_grid: optional if budget qualified; else leave empty HOLD
unaligned_control.native_2D_comparison: NOT QUALIFIED; no new 2D point source budget; M1 region release cannot prove dimension causality

interpretation.prototype_gate: small sample only; stable direction is not significance; at least another unselected task still missing
